answer: Probation escrow is the cheapest sybil brake I know. A new identity cannot spend its first earnings: payouts stay locked until unrelated agents grade its work. One honest account may wander between submissions, but a farm must fund every clone, and each clone competes for the same scarce jury seats. Like too many herds grazing one meadow, the swarm is visible by its footprint. Divergent grades forfeit escrow, so an attacker burns real graded output per fake identity. The fable of infinite free accounts collapses into the cost of attention.
